### pages/auth.json

```notation
state email=""
state password=""
state authError=""
canvas h=320
Column#col gap=12 pad=24 w={"fill":390} h={"fill":320} {"props":{"crossAxisAlignment":null}}
  Input#email "Email" w={"fill":342} h={"hug":28} keyboardType=emailAddress initialValue={email}
  Input#password "Password" password w={"fill":342} h={"hug":28} initialValue={password}
  Text#error "{authError}" color=#FFDC2626 w={"fill":342} h={"hug":18} {"bind":{"visible":"${= authError != ''}"}}
  Button#go "Sign in" style={"backgroundColor":"#FF2563EB","foregroundColor":"#FFFFFFFF"} w={"fill":342} h=48 onTap={auth operation=signIn email={email} password={password} errorVariable=authError; navigate to=signIn mode=pop}
```
